title: Emergency Medical Technician
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Requirements for the Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Develop the necessary skills and knowledge in human anatomy and physiology for basic level prehospital care.
Differentiate diagnostic signs and interpretations of sudden illness and injuries for basic level prehospital care.
Demonstrate the necessary skills and procedures of basic emergency rescue and care.

notes: The catalog text begins mid-sentence; the start of the program description (which may name careers) is cut off, so careers were left empty. The text mentions preparation for EMT certification but names no career outright.
The 'Total Units 10' printed under the course list was recorded as the certificate total and as the block's stated total.
EMED 201 (Emergency Medical Responder, 3 units) appears only as a recommended elective and is not in the closed list; it does not count toward the total.
The 'Program Outcomes' list is printed for the program as a whole; this certificate is the only award on the page and shares it.

The description lists the Commission on Dental Accreditation's phone number in the Los Angeles County EMS Agency contact sentence, and gives an EMS Authority renewal date of 4/30/2024. Both look like stale or erroneous copy to review for the 2026-2027 catalog.
